properties.description: scripts/run_bulk_extraction.py --dry-run calls spend.declare() BEFORE branching on the dry-run flag, so a dry run writes a ceiling declaration onto the append-only spend ledger (state/spend_ledger.jsonl) for a run that never dispatches a call. A dry run exists to PRICE a run before committing to it; declaring is the commitment. Consequences: (a) a caller who only wants a projection must invent a --ceiling-tokens value, and that fabricated number is then permanently on the ledger as a declared ceiling with the task file named as its authority; (b) the real ceiling, derived from the dry run's own output, must then be a superseding re-declare, so the ledger reads as an operator ceiling correction when nothing was corrected. Found while executing chunked_pilot ADDENDUM-03 §2 on 2026-08-29: the section specified this runner, and scripts/chunked_pilot.py --phase dry_run was used instead and the discrepancy reported in the RESULT. Fix: move the declare() call inside the non-dry-run branch and make --ceiling-tokens not required when --dry-run is set. Second, smaller defect in the same command: --dry-run has no chunker, so under a chunked profile it prints whole documents and cannot produce the per-document chunk counts a chunked profile needs priced.
